blocking_findings.summary: [P1] Apply the lost-race reread when fingerprint retirement loses its fence (apps/core/src/runtime/group-agent-runner-context-ceiling.ts:273): The fingerprint preflight awaits `retireProviderSessionWithEvent` but ignores its `undefined` result and unconditionally clears the resume identifiers while retaining the original `turnContext` and enabling replacement persistence.

T2-AC4: R6 lost-race re-read, BOTH branches: on a lost ceiling transition the turn context is re-read with `hydrateMemory: false`, and the carried memory block is reused ONLY when the agent session id and the null-normalised `reset_at` generation both still match. On a mismatch the carried block is DISCARDED and memory rehydrated, because decision 0078's exactly-once hydration is per turn and a mismatch means a concurrent reset. Both branches carry regression coverage — a match-only implementation would leak a retired session's memory into the replacement.
